d614b55d-d9f6-5347-8d02-2d219d621a09.content: Keep the main text to the total and major categories, and place quantities, unit rates, and assumptions in one compact budget table or appendix.

24500129-4b07-564f-ba67-39e40d7d7860.content: Give each cost category, quantity, unit rate, and subtotal a stable row in the separate budget table.

07bad409-af9c-512a-b829-7ceb28273f91.content: Put the estimate basis in a dedicated table column so one assumption can be checked or revised without rewriting the narrative.

abf6d361-c2eb-512f-87e0-f3af9c5eb677.content: Readers can verify arithmetic and compare categories faster in a consistent table than in amounts distributed across prose.

473cf3ca-9832-5d9c-97df-974f1d9b0d1b.content: Revise one table row and its subtotal when an estimate changes instead of repeating the new amount across several prose paragraphs.

675956de-2c61-53e1-bb89-9b49d92558ba.content: Keep detailed arithmetic out of the main argument when readers can reach the complete table from a clear reference.

f4371f72-f222-5066-b2f4-0a6be5d6865e.content: The user tends to interrupt the argument with long cost enumerations when no separate budget table is available.
